jobs.description:
En tant que Data Product Manager, tu seras en immersion au sein des équipes de nos clients.

Tu travailleras pour des sociétés allant de la startup française au grand groupe international, dans des secteurs aussi divers que les transports, l’assurance, le luxe, la musique, le tourisme ou encore la banque en ligne.

Que ce soit pour identifier et cadrer les cas d’usage pertinents pour lancer un nouveau Produit Data ou pour accompagner le développement au sein d’une équipe de Data Scientists et Data Engineers, nos Data PM sont là pour apporter une vision et une démarche produit sur des sujets de pointe !  


 

Ta mission au quotidien :
  • Identifier et prioriser les besoins utilisateurs et business du client
  • Définir la stratégie et roadmap du produit.
  • Etablir une vision produit “claire” identifier les incertitudes et mettre en place les démarches pertinentes pour les lever
  • Savoir définir le MVP d’un Produit Data et les itérations qui permettront d’atteindre la vision 
  • Analyser les performances techniques et métier du produit, identifier les leviers d’amélioration et animer la co-création de solutions pertinentes
  • Déterminer, rédiger et prioriser les fonctionnalités du produit sous forme d’Epics et d’User Stories avec les équipes métiers, business et technique.
  • Créer et s’assurer de la bonne tenue de ton backlog.
  • Suivre les différentes cérémonies agiles comme : le sprint planning, les daily meetings, des rétrospectives, des démonstrations au client.
  • Collaborer avec l’UX Designer pour concevoir l'expérience utilisateur.
  • Participer à la mise en place de tests utilisateurs et en analyser les retours.
  • Maintenir la roadmap à court et moyen termes en prenant en compte les impacts business et les contraintes de développement.
  • Communiquer auprès de l’ensemble des parties prenantes.

    • Ton profil :
  • Tu as une très bonne culture Data Science : tu en connais les champs d’application, tu comprends les mécanismes et tu connais les enjeux de la création de Produit basé sur un modèle de Machine Learning 
  • Tu fais parfaitement la différence entre Culture Projet et Culture Produit.
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance théorique des pratiques agiles (méthodo Scrum & Kanban entre autres).
  • Les méthodes de création de produits numériques tels que le Design Thinking et le Lean Startup, n’ont plus de secret pour toi !
  • Tu es capable d’identifier, prioriser les besoins utilisateurs, communiquer des idées et être force de proposition.
  • Tu sais adopter le bon niveau de discours pour aligner des équipes très techniques et métier sur une vision et un objectif commun.

    • **LES petits (GROS) PLUS :**
  • Tu as des notions de Python et/ou Spark
  • Tu sais te servir d’un Notebook 
  • Tu as déjà suivi un MOOC comme celui d’Andrew Ng pour comprendre en profondeur comment le Machine Learning fonctionne
  • Tu maîtrises des logiciels de conception tel que Sketch, Adobe XD, Figma.
  • Tu sais mettre en place des tests A/B.
  • You speak English.

    • Et bien sûr, tu es passionné(e) de digital !

    Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

jobs.description:
Your mission

As our Senior Product Manager, you will play a key role in driving ProGlove's software and solution offering.  
You will operate as the “CEO” of the software and service business inside the company, with accountability for strategy, P&L, growth, customer outcomes, and long-term value creation. The mission is not to manage an existing business. The mission is to build one. Success will have a measurable impact on the company’s growth profile, competitive positioning and profitability. The role reports directly to the CPO and will be part of the product management team. 


Your profile

Who you are: 

  • Commercially obsessed and outcome-driven
  • You think in terms of value, outcomes, and usage-not features
  • You are comfortable working in dynamic and evolving environments
  • You can navigate both technical and commercial discussions
  • You are curious, pragmatic, and impact-driven
  • You have strong business acumen 
  • You are motivated by building something that changes how a company operates
  • Able to balance short-term performance with long-term value creation
 
 
Core accountabilities 
  • Monitor and drivetheP&L for theproduct line
  • ARR growth
  • Attach rate
  • Net Revenue Retention
  • Customer adoption and value realization
  • Pricing and monetization strategy
  • Strategic partnerships
 
Required qualifications 
  • 5to8+ years of experience in product management, preferably in software, cloud, SaaS, or IoT environments
  • Proven experience delivering cloud-based or SaaS products
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Ability to translate customer needs into scalable product solutions
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence teams and senior leadership.
  • Professional fluency in English.
Nice to have 
  • Experience in industrial technology, IoT, hardware, embedded systems
  • Experience with establishing and changing SaaS business models
  • Experience with IoT platforms
  • Background in enterprise or B2B software
  • Familiarity with microservices and cloud-native architectures
  • Experience with product-led growth, monetization


Why us?

At ProGlove, we're building technology that empowers frontline workers to work smarter, faster, and safer. As a Senior Product Manager, you'll be a key pillar in defining the future products and solutions and making them commercially successful. 
What you can expect: 

  • A highly autonomous role with ownership of strategic, cross-functional initiatives.
  • The opportunity to influenceProGlove'sbusiness models.
  • Hybrid working model with regular collaboration with our Munich headquarters.
  • Flexible working hours and modern equipment.
  • Learning and development opportunities, including dedicated learning time and our School of Glove academy.
  • Comprehensive health and wellbeing programs through ProHealth.
  • Personalized local benefits depending on your location.
  • Employee referralprogramand regular international team events.
  • An international, collaborative culture where ownership, continuous improvement, and innovation are encouraged.


What success looks like

Within your first 12-18 months, you will: 

Strategy & Vision 

  • Define the long-term strategy and positioning of the business
  • Establish a category-leading position in operational intelligence and frontline analytics
  • Prioritize markets, verticals,accountsand use cases with outsized growth potential
  • Make investment and resource allocation decisions that maximize long-term value creation
  • Balance innovation, execution, and commercial impact

Commercial Growth 

  • Lead software solutions go-to-market strategy across sales,marketingand customer-facing functions
  • Build repeatable ARR growth engines
  • Develop pricing,packagingand commercial models
  • Expand software penetration across the installed base
  • Build expansion and renewal motions

Leadership  

  • Create a culture of accountability, customerobsessionand execution excellence
  • Align Product, Engineering, Sales, CSM and Marketing around business outcomes
  • Establish operating rhythms, businessreviewsand performance management disciplines
  • Resolve cross-functional conflicts and drive rapid decision-making

Customer Outcomes 

  • Act as executive sponsor for strategic customers and lighthouse deployments
  • Ensure measurable customer outcomes and ROI realization
  • Stay close to customer operations and emerging industry trends
  • Translate customer needs into business priorities
  • Drive adoption,retentionand expansion through customer value creation
 


Meet your team

You'll join our Product & Engineering organization, working closely with Product Managers, Engineering teams, Commercial stakeholders, Customer Success, and Leadership to deliver innovative connected worker solutions. 
Our team is focused on bringing new innovations that are appreciated by our customers and to continuously strengthen ProGloves portfolio. We work collaboratively across the entire company and value chain. Together we are not about growing products only; it is about changing how the company grows.

jobs.description:

At Apaleo, we're revolutionizing the hospitality industry with our API-first property management platform, giving businesses the power to build a tech ecosystem that enhances both guest experiences and staff efficiency. With seamless integrations to hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, our platform simplifies operations, elevates the guest journey, and drives revenue growth.

Are you ready to make an impact? We're looking for a Sr. Product Manager Fiscal & Legal (f/m/d) to join our dynamic team and help shape the future of hospitality technology and poised to propel Apaleo into 180+ countries. Be a pivotal part of crafting a fiscal/legal framework that empowers Apaleo to swiftly become compliant in new territories!

What You'll Be Up To 

  • Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation. 
  • Turning roadmap priorities into clear, well scoped work your engineering team can execute against. 
  • Balancing planned roadmap delivery with the steady stream of regulatory and reactive work that comes with keeping Apaleo compliant in markets we've already launched. 
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks. 
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting. 
  • Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable. 
  • Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work. 
  • Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years. 

 

What You'll Bring to the Team 

  • At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment. 
  • A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held. 
  • Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth. 
  • Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day. 
  • A genuine curiosity for complex domains. You dig into the details rather than staying at the surface, and you're not afraid of a codebase with some history to it. 
  • Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 

Extra Awesome Points For 

  • Experience with fiscal, tax or legal compliance topics, for example in fintech, e-commerce or ERP systems. This is a genuine nice to have, not a requirement. 
  • Familiarity with platform products where you expose APIs for others to build on. 

 

What We Offer 

  • A diverse, international team. Work alongside passionate people from all sorts of backgrounds, with a genuinely global perspective. 
  • A flat, flexible structure. You'll get real autonomy and ownership, without unnecessary hierarchy in the way. 
  • A key role in a fast growing startup, right in the heart of Munich. 
  • Fair, transparent compensation with a clear peer review and career progression plan. 
  • Flexible working, with hours and remote options that depend on the role. 
  • Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations. 
  • 30 days of holiday to properly switch off and recharge. 
  • Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered. 

 

How You'll Make an Impact 

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. Your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we can bring our platform to new markets, and the systems you help build will make life easier for every property that runs on Apaleo. Your voice matters here, and your impact will be easy to see.

KoRo is scaling its fulfillment setup across multiple warehouses and markets. As our Senior Product Manager - Outbound Logistics & Returns (m/f/d), you will own and shape the systems behind the journey from order placement to delivery and returns, making them more automated, scalable and efficient. 

  • Own the full order-to-delivery and returns journey, from Shop through ERP/OMS and WMS to carrier integrations, including tracking updates back to the customer
  • Shape our distributed fulfillment setup by designing the product logic for automated warehouse allocation and order routing across multiple warehouses
  • Identify and prioritize automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention, improve time-to-ship and optimize cost per parcel
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, using data and relevant metrics to identify problems, set priorities and measure impact
  • Validate significant product opportunities through hypothesis-driven discovery and experimentation before committing engineering capacity
  • Work closely with Engineering, Logistics & Operations, as well as external 3PL and carrier partners, to build scalable and reliable outbound flows
  • Ensure new solutions support our evolving architecture and maintain platform stability and scalability throughout ongoing replatforming


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience with backend, integration-heavy or operational products
  • Hands-on experience with commerce operations systems such as OMS, ERP, WMS, carrier integrations and API-based partner flows
  • A proven track record of automating operational processes and delivering measurable improvements
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with KPIs, dashboards and operational data
  • The ability to navigate complex dependencies and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience with multi-warehouse fulfillment, international shipping, EDI, or both D2C and B2B/retail order flows is a plus
  • Fluent English; German is a plus


What's In It For You

  • Smart Working & Flexibility: Flexible working hours, hybrid work, and 20 days of workation. We trust you to take ownership: you deliver on our shared goals and structure your day in the way that works best for you. You’ll also start with 28 days of vacation, increasing by one additional day per year of tenure (capped at 30 days), so you always have time to recharge
  • Growth & Setup: A structured onboarding plan to get you started, plus a dedicated development budget for your personal and professional growth. You’ll also receive your own MacBook and a fully equipped office setup with monitors and height-adjustable desks.
  • KoRo Life & Extras: Free snacks, and barista coffee in the office, 20% discount in the KoRo Online-Shop, and exclusive perks with partner companies. On top of that, a fully funded BVG ticket (Jobticket), a subsidy for your fitness membership (Urban Sports Club, Hansefit, or FitX), and a company pension scheme (bAV) via Ginkgo.
  • Shared Moments: Regular team events and company parties to celebrate milestones and successes together.


We're looking for People who share our Mindset

For us, it's not just about the what, but above all about the how. You'll be a perfect fit for us if you have the following mindset:

  • You take initiative and ownership. You don't wait for a perfect brief or a mandate to get started. When you see an opportunity, a risk, or something that can be improved - you act. When things don't go as planned, you look at your own contribution first and step up, without waiting to be asked.
  • You thrive in change. Shifting priorities and evolving processes don't slow you down. You adapt fast and keep moving.
  • You build, you don't wait. When something is missing - a tool, a process, a solution - you create it. You prefer a working MVP over a perfect plan and iterate from there.
  • You think in leverage. You question how things are done, prioritize ruthlessly, and find smarter paths to better outcomes. You don't mistake effort for impact.
  • You're a team player, humble and genuinely kind. You collaborate in and across teams, care about the people around you, and bring sparkles to the room. You speak up when you disagree, commit fully once a decision is made, and actively make the people around you better.

Own it – Move fast – Build it – Create impact – Lift others

  • Gestalte die Automatisierung des Schadenprozesses: regelbasierte und KI-gestützte Schadenprüfung, Dunkelverarbeitung und effiziente Workflows bis zur Regulierung und Auszahlung.

jobs.title: Product Lead @Panora
jobs.description:
🚀 Why this role

Panora is building the AI platform that will redefine how insurance brokers work across Europe.

The problem is structural: brokers spend the majority of their time on repetitive, manual tasks (switching between carrier portals, chasing documents, re-entering data) instead of advising clients. The result? Underinsured businesses, frustrated brokers, and a profession stuck in the past.

We believe AI can fix this. Not by replacing brokers, but by giving every broker the capabilities of the best one in the room: on every case, at every critical moment. That's the vision we've been pitching to VCs. That's what we're building.

Panora has live product, first paying customers, and a roadmap far bigger than our current team. The foundations are solid, built with Hexa's support, with strong technical and product groundwork already in place. Now we need someone to take ownership of that vision and turn it into a product brokers love.

You'll be our first Product hire. You won't just manage a backlog, you'll shape how an entire industry modernizes. You'll own the roadmap, build the product function from scratch, and make sure every feature we ship moves us closer to a world where no one is underinsured.

🎯 Your mission

Take Panora's product from "it works" to "it's the reference": structure discovery, relentlessly prioritize, and quickly scope the features that unlock adoption and retention among brokerage firms.

📋 What you'll do

Discovery: understand, explore, prototype

  • Field discovery: spend time with brokers (demos, calls, on-site visits) to understand their day-to-day quoting workflow and spot the real friction points, not surface-level requests.

  • Insurance domain interface: translate the constraints of brokerage and carriers (products, quoting rules, regulation) into product decisions.

  • Product design: frame flows and screens (with engineering support), keeping a high bar on simplicity for non-technical users.

Delivery: prioritize, spec, ship

  • Roadmap & prioritization with founders: build and continuously arbitrate the product roadmap, make trade-offs between business impact, technical debt and speed, and say no.

  • Specs & delivery: write clear specs, scope work with engineers, and drive delivery end to end through to production.

  • Product voice internally: align sales and ops on the "what" and the "why," bridging customer needs and what we build. Own the weekly product meeting.

  • Data & impact: instrument, measure usage (activation, retention, feature adoption via PostHog) and close the loop between product decisions and results.

Quality: make the AI trustworthy

  • AI agentic workflows: design and iterate on the AI agents at Panora's core (multi-carrier quoting, document generation, compliance checks). You define what the agent does, how it handles edge cases, and where the human stays in the loop. You work closely with engineering to tune prompts, evaluate outputs, and push coverage.

  • AI feedback loop: build the instrumentation that makes AI outputs improvable: capture broker corrections, flag low-confidence outputs, and turn real-world usage into a continuous improvement cycle. You own the gap between "AI generates" and "broker trusts."

✅ What we're looking for

  • 4-6 years of product experience, including at least one role in a B2B SaaS environment with real roadmap ownership.

  • You've already driven a product end to end: discovery → specs → delivery → impact measurement, autonomously.

  • Excellent prioritization and trade-off skills: you know how to focus a small team on what matters.

  • Analytical rigor: you make decisions with data, not gut feel alone.

  • Crystal-clear communication, written and spoken, with both technical AND non-technical audiences (customers, founders).

  • Experience with AI / automation-driven products.

  • Strong appetite for a complex, regulated domain : insurance doesn't scare you, it interests you.

  • You're comfortable with early-stage velocity and move forward without being told how.

➕ Bonus

  • Knowledge of insurance, brokerage, or fintech/insurtech.

  • Design sensibility (Figma) and the ability to produce your own prototypes/ASCII.

  • You've already been a company's first product hire or built a product function from scratch.

💡 Your first 90 days

  • 30 days: full immersion : you master the product, the brokerage market and the quoting workflow; you've spoken with 10+ customers/prospects and mapped the friction points.

  • 60 days: you've taken ownership of the roadmap, set up a simple prioritization process, and shipped a first improvement with measurable impact.

  • 90 days: you're Panora's product point of reference : the quarterly roadmap is scoped, instrumented, and aligned with sales and founders.

🎁 What we offer

  • Compensation: €70-90k depending on profile + BSPCE (stock options) (early-stage range, to be adjusted based on seniority).

  • The role of first Product at a Seed-stage insurtech: maximum impact, you build the function and will grow it as we scale.

  • Direct access to founders and customers, zero bullshit layers, fast decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Data APIs)
jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

 

9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com. But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.

 

These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.

 

The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy. You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors. You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data. The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).

 

You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.

 

This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

 
 

What You'll Do

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub).

  • Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential

  • Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning

  • Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application

  • Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broader launch

  • Shape the commercial model for API products: packaging, tiering, usage-based pricing, distribution controls, and entitlement structures that capture the value of programmatic data access

 

Data Quality, Infrastructure & Compliance

 

  • Partner with the Head of Analytics to ensure data products meet the reliability, freshness, and accuracy standards that enterprise clients building automated systems expect

  • Define SLAs for data delivery (latency, uptime, completeness) and build the monitoring and metering infrastructure to back them up

  • Own the entitlements and access control layer: ensuring the right clients can access the right data under the right contractual terms, with appropriate usage limits and controls

  • Work with Legal to define data usage policies, including restrictions on redistribution, AI training and model embedding, and onward use, protecting 9fin's data IP while enabling legitimate client workflows

  • Establish feedback loops between API consumers and domain teams so that usage patterns and client requests improve the underlying data over time

 

Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM

 

  • Coordinate across platform engineering, analytics engineering, domain squads, and the Head of Analytics to align priorities and ship a cohesive product without a dedicated squad

  • Influence teams you do not manage; build relationships that make cross-functional delivery work despite competing priorities

  • Support the shift to a solution-selling GTM motion: work with Sales and Customer Success on partner selection, POC design, technical onboarding, and commercial structuring for API deals

  • Engage directly with enterprise clients and their technical teams during pilots and integrations; this is a client-facing role, not a back-office one

  • Communicate strategy, progress, and trade-offs transparently to leadership, engineering, and commercial teams

  • Translate technical API and data infrastructure concepts into language that non-technical stakeholders (Sales, Legal, Finance) can act on

 

What We're Looking For

 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years building API products, data platforms, or data distribution products at a B2B company

  • Experience designing APIs for external consumers: you have opinions on schema design, versioning strategies, rate limiting, and what makes developer documentation actually useful

  • Track record of shipping data products where you managed the full lifecycle: from defining what data to expose, through schema design, to commercial packaging and client onboarding

  • Understanding of data infrastructure concepts: data pipelines, warehouses, ETL/ELT, data modelling, and platforms like Snowflake

  • Comfortable with SQL and Python and capable of interrogating data to validate quality, understand usage patterns, and inform product decisions

  • Experience working in a solution-selling or partner-led GTM model: you have been involved in POCs, pilots, or co-development with enterprise clients, not just self-serve product launches

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functionally without a dedicated team: you coordinate across engineering, data, and commercial functions through influence, not authority

  • Strong commercial instinct: you understand how enterprise data buyers evaluate providers, and you can shape a product that competes on data quality, coverage, and ease of integration

  • Clear communicator who can translate between technical and commercial audiences

 

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with credit markets, debt instruments, or how buy-side/sell-side firms consume financial data

  • Experience with Snowflake data sharing, marketplace listings, or similar cloud data distribution mechanisms

  • Experience building entitlements, licensing, or access control systems for data products

  • Understanding of data licensing, redistribution terms, or AI usage policies in the context of enterprise data products

 

Benefits

 

  • Competitive, market-benchmarked salary

  • Pension with 7% company matching

  • Private medical insurance, paid sick leave, income protection, group life assurance

  • Season ticket and cycle-to-work schemes

  • Hybrid flexibility with up to 3 months annual work abroad

  • 25 holiday days plus local public holidays (exchangeable)

  • One-month paid sabbatical after 5 years; enhanced parental leave

  • Professional development budget and regular social events

 

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

jobs.title: Product Ops IA / Product Manager Ops - (H/F)
jobs.description:
Mindset

Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que l’IA ne transforme pas seulement les produits, mais aussi la façon de les concevoir, de les construire et de les faire évoluer. Discovery, delivery, coordination, documentation, pilotage : tout le Product Development Lifecycle est en train d’être réinventé.

La plupart des entreprises ont déjà démarré. Elles ont des POCs, des power users, des outils partout, parfois des gains individuels visibles. Mais elles peinent encore à transformer cette énergie en gain collectif, en nouveaux standards de travail et en performance durable.

C’est là qu’intervient l’AI Product Ops.

Pas pour agir comme théoricien, mais pour repenser concrètement les modes de fonctionnement produit-tech, designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, outiller les bons workflows, et faire de l’IA un levier d’efficience organisationnelle dans le delivery de produits digitaux.

Chez Thiga, nous ne nous arrêtons pas à la recommandation. Nous construisons avec nos clients. Nous testons, nous outillons, nous faisons adopter.

Le job

En immersion chez le client, tu interviens au cœur de l’organisation produit-tech pour refondre le Product Development Lifecycle avec l’IA.

Ton rôle : identifier où l’IA crée le plus de valeur, repenser les processus, faire émerger de nouveaux standards de travail, et construire les premiers outils, skills ou agents qui rendent cette transformation réelle.

Tu es à la fois :

  • un profil hands-on, capable de builder pour montrer l’exemple ;

  • un profil ops, capable de simplifier et fiabiliser les workflows ;

  • un profil change, capable d’embarquer les équipes dans de nouvelles pratiques ;

Concrètement, dans le cadre de tes missions, tu seras amené·e à

  • Auditer les processus de discovery, delivery et go-to-market pour identifier les frictions, les tâches à faible valeur, les dépendances inutiles et les opportunités de délégation à l’IA.

  • Reconcevoir des processus de travail plus simples, plus rapides et plus robustes, en intégrant nativement l’IA dans le fonctionnement des équipes.

  • Designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, en clarifiant les rôles, les responsabilités, les points de contrôle et les conditions de réussite.

  • Mettre en place les outils, standards et rituels nécessaires à une exécution plus fluide : documentation, pilotage, reporting, coordination, partage de connaissance, qualité d’exécution.

  • Builder toi-même des skills, assistants, automatisations ou agents simples adaptés au contexte client, pour outiller des usages concrets et immédiats.

  • Contribuer au product building de manière très opérationnelle, pour démontrer par la preuve ce que de nouveaux modes de travail rendent possible.

  • Former et accompagner les équipes produit, design, tech et métier dans l’adoption de nouvelles pratiques, de nouveaux outils et de nouveaux réflexes de travail.

  • Mesurer l’impact des évolutions mises en place et ajuster en continu ce qui doit l’être.

  • Aider les clients à éviter trois écueils fréquents : beaucoup d’énergie pour peu d’impact, des POCs qui ne scalent pas, et des gains individuels qui ne se traduisent jamais en gains système.

À quoi ressemble le succès dans ce rôle

Au bout de quelques mois chez un client, tu as contribué à faire émerger des résultats visibles et mesurables :

  • des workflows de discovery et de delivery revus, simplifiés et mieux maîtrisés ;

  • des usages IA prioritaires cadrés, outillés et réellement adoptés ;

  • plusieurs agents ou assistants internes en production d’usage ;

  • une baisse nette du temps passé sur les tâches à faible valeur ;

  • une amélioration tangible de la rapidité d’exécution et de l’efficience collective.

  • la satisfaction des équipes accompagnées ;

Ce que ce rôle n’est pas

Ce poste n’est pas fait pour toi si tu cherches principalement à faire :

  • du conseil hors sol, très conceptuel, sans opérationnalisation rapide ;

  • du portfolio management ;

  • de la gestion d’infrastructure ou de plateforme ;

  • de l’industrialisation technique à grande échelle ;

L’AI Product Ops n’est ni un PMO, ni un architecte de plateforme, ni un ML engineer. C’est un rôle à l’intersection de l’efficience organisationnelle, du build, et de la conduite du changement.

Qui es-tu ?

Tu as au moins 6 ans d’expérience, avec un parcours qui t’a donné une compréhension forte du fonctionnement réel des équipes produit-tech.

Tu es probablement :

  • un·e coach agile aguerri au passé de dev, ayant une approche hands-on

  • un·e Product Ops senior ;

  • ou un·e Product Manager avec une très forte fibre ops ;

Et surtout :

  • Tu as déjà travaillé au sein d’équipes produit, au plus près du delivery et de la réalité terrain.

  • Tu sais analyser un flux de valeur de développement, repérer les goulots d’étranglement, et transformer une friction en dispositif concret.

  • Tu utilises déjà l’IA au quotidien dans ta pratique professionnelle (claude code, cursor, …).

  • Tu sais tirer parti de copilotes, assistants, outils d’automatisation, outils de documentation augmentée et solutions d’orchestration légère.

  • Tu es capable de builder toi-même des agents ou assistants simples, sans prétendre être la personne qui les industrialisera techniquement à grande échelle.

  • Tu sais passer de l’idée à l’outil, puis de l’outil à l’adoption.

  • Tu es à l’aise aussi bien avec des équipes opérationnelles qu’avec des interlocuteurs de direction.

  • Tu as suffisamment de culture produit pour ne pas confondre vitesse et valeur.

Ton savoir-être

  • Tu es énergique, pragmatique et orienté impact.

  • Tu aimes autant transformer un mode de fonctionnement que mettre les mains dans les outils.

Et en interne, au sein de Thiga

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. 

We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.

Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Own:

  • Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
  • Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
  • Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
  • Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.
  • Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.
  • Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.
  • Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.

What Success Looks Like:
  • You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
  • Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
  • Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
  • Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
  • You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
  • You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.


What You Bring

  • Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
  • Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
  • Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
  • Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
  • Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
  • Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
  • Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
  • Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

jobs.title: Engineering Team Lead, Mistral Cloud
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible, from compute orchestration and Kubernetes to bare metal, storage, and networking.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

You will own the systems that power our cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on role. You spend the majority of your time in the code, in architecture decisions, and in the hardest technical problems the team faces. The rest you spend leading a small squad of engineers and partnering with Product Managers to ship what customers depend on.

You design the architecture. You write the code. You make the technical calls. Then you clear the path for your engineers to do their best work and push past what they thought they could do. The decisions you make here shape how our infrastructure scales from today's footprint to a gigawatt, and how we turn frontier AI research into production systems used by millions.

jobs.title: Team Lead Software Production Support (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Quantum Systems, we are redefining the boundaries of autonomous drone technology. We develop and deploy some of the world’s most advanced UAVs, combining highly integrated hardware, embedded software, sensors, compute platforms, and production processes into reliable systems for demanding real-world missions.​

As part of our Software Production Support Team, you will work at the intersection of serial UAV production, embedded software, firmware deployment, production diagnostics, automation, and traceability. You will help ensure that every drone leaving production is equipped with the correct software, firmware, configuration, and documentation needed for safe and reliable operation.​

Between hands-on troubleshooting on the production floor, flashing microcontrollers and compute modules, analyzing system behavior, improving diagnostic workflows, developing production tools, and refining digital work instructions, you will play a key role in turning advanced UAV technology into stable, scalable, and efficient serial production



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Leading and developing the Software Production Support team​.

  • Prioritizing urgent production support topics and long-term improvement activities​.

  • Identifying bottlenecks, recurring issues, and process weaknesses in serial production​.

  • Defining robust processes for microcontroller flashing, NVIDIA Orin installation, firmware updates, diagnostics, and recovery workflows​.

  • Driving automation and standardization of software-related production steps​.

  • Ensuring that production tools are reliable, versioned, documented, and maintainable​.

  • Defining requirements for production traceability and digital paper trail documentation​.

  • Coordinating software-related production escalations with Engineering, Quality, and Industrialization​.

  • Ensuring that Operations1 work instructions are technically correct and reflect the real production process​.

  • Monitoring KPIs such as production downtime, flashing success rate, recurring issues, and software-related first-pass yield​.

  • Turning production issues into sustainable process, tooling, or engineering improvements.



What you bring to the team:

  • Several years of experience in embedded systems, production software, manufacturing test, industrialization, or technical production support​.

  • Experience in serial production or manufacturing environments​.

  • Strong understanding of embedded software, firmware flashing, production diagnostics, and system integration​.

  • Experience with Linux-based embedded systems, ideally NVIDIA Jetson / Orin or similar platforms​.

  • Hands-on experience with scripting, automation, production tooling, and diagnostic workflows​.

  • Ability to analyze complex issues across software, electronics, tooling, process, and operator interaction​.

  • Experience coordinating or leading technical teams​.

  • Strong communication skills across production operators, engineers, quality teams, and management​.

  • A structured, hands-on mindset with the ability to distinguish one-off production issues from systemic process weaknesses​.

  • Ideally, experience in drones, robotics, aerospace, automotive, defense, or industrial electronics​.

  • Ideally, knowledge of CAN, UART, Ethernet, USB, SWD, JTAG, I2C, SPI, MES, ERP, traceability systems, or Operations1.

jobs.title: Scientific Data Architect -Darmstadt or Düsseldorf, Germany
jobs.description:
About TetraScience

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world’s leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience’s growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft.

In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review “The Tetra Way,” authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you.

Who You Are

You are a product-minded, outcome-obsessed driver of technical scientific solutions.

You a high velocity self-starter. You refuse to let uncertainty obstruct your path to designing and building solutions.

You roll up your sleeves, try things out, and get things done. You do not hesitate to prototype, demo, and build in order to accelerate delivery of products for your end users.

You thrive in environments where you can collaborate with scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform complex scientific data into actionable outcomes. Your ability to engage with scientists and business leaders alike makes you a key player in maximizing the value of scientific data.

With rich experience applying cutting edge data methodologies to the biopharma R&D domain, you bridge understanding between present-day pain points and generalizable solutions.

You are an insatiable learner, with a track record of deeply learning new tools, methods, and domains.

You fundamentally embody the principles of extreme ownership and have a demonstrated history of building extensible data models and applications for Biopharma end users to maximize value from their data via analysis and integration with AI/ML.

This role will require extreme self-discipline and determination as we forge a category that will fundamentally and forever change the life science industry.

What You Have Done

  • PhD with +4 years or Masters with +8 years of industry experience in life sciences  with extensive domain knowledge in drug discovery (target ID through lead optimization), preclinical development, CMC (all drug modalities), or product quality testing.
  • Proven track record of defining, designing, prototyping, and implementing productized AI/ML-driven use cases in cloud environments
  • Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including product managers, software engineers, and scientific stakeholders.
  • Performed extensive exploratory data analysis and workflow optimization to enable scientific outcomes not previously possible.
  • Engaged diverse audiences, from scientists to executive stakeholders using your excellent communication and storytelling abilities.
  • Advised scientists in a consulting capacity to further research, development, and quality testing outcomes.

Requirements

What You Will Do

  • You will be a critical team member in a unique partnership to industrialize Scientific AI. As such, you will engage directly with customers onsite a couple of days per week in the Frankfurt Region, building strong relationships, deeply understanding their scientific data challenges and requirements, and accelerating solutions.
  • Design and implement extensible, reusable data models that efficiently capture and organize scientific data for scientific use cases, ensuring scalability and future adaptability.
  • Translate scientific data workflows into robust solutions leveraging the Tetra Data Platform.
  • Own, scope, prototype, and implement solutions including:
    • Data model design (tabular & JSON)
    • Python-based parser development.
    • Lab software (e.g., ELN/LIMS) integration via APIs.
    • Data visualization and app development in Python (using app frameworks like Streamlit and plotting tools like holoviews and Plotly) 
    • Collaborate with Scientific Business Analysts (SBAs), customer scientists and applied AI engineers to develop and deploy models (ML, AI, mechanistic, statistical, hybrid)
    • Programmatically interrogating proprietary instrument output files.
  • Dynamically iterate with scientific end users and technical stakeholders to rapidly drive solution development and adoption through regular demos and meetings
  • Proactively communicate implementation progress and deliver demos to customer stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the product team to build and prioritize our roadmap by understanding customers’ pain points within and outside Tetra Data Platform.
  • Rapidly learn new technologies (e.g., new AWS services or scientific analysis applications) to develop and troubleshoot use cases
  • Business proficiency of German required (C1 level)

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary and equity in a fast-growing company.
  • Supportive, team-oriented culture of continuous improvement.
  • Generous paid time off (PTO).
  • Flexible working arrangements - Remote work when not at Customer Sites

We are not currently providing visa sponsorship for this position.

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Developer Experience / Tooling (Golang/PHP) (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Shopware ist eine international führende Open‑Commerce‑Plattform für ambitionierte Unternehmen im digitalen Handel. Mit einem API‑First‑Ansatz, maximaler Flexibilität und einer starken Community schaffen wir zukunftsorientierte E‑Commerce‑Lösungen. Unsere 450 Mitarbeitenden in ganz Europa teilen eine Leidenschaft für Innovation, Offenheit und Teamgeist. 

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du an Tools wie der shopware-cli, die viele Entwickler täglich nutzen, um Shopware zu entwickeln, zu testen, bereitzustellen und zu betreiben. Diese Tools sind das Eingangstor zu unserem Open-Source-Ökosystem – und ihre Developer Experience prägt unmittelbar, wie Entwickler Shopware wahrnehmen.

Du hast klare Vorstellungen davon, wie sich eine gute CLI verhalten sollte? Du hast schon mit gh oder anderen CLI-Tools gearbeitet, die deinen Alltag deutlich einfacher gemacht haben, und dir dabei gedacht: „Genau so sollte sich das anfühlen“? Dann könnte diese Rolle genau das Richtige für dich sein. Als Software Engineer im Developer Experience (DX) Tooling Team arbeitest du an den Tools und technischen Grundlagen, mit denen Entwickler Shopware entwickeln, erweitern, testen und betreiben. Mit deinen Beiträgen gestaltest du unmittelbar mit, wie angenehm, effizient und zuverlässig die Entwicklung auf unserer Plattform ist.

Diese Position kann vor Ort, hybrid oder vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder in bestimmten europäischen Ländern, in denen wir registriert sind, besetzt werden. Dein Arbeitsort wird im Voraus abgestimmt und bildet die Grundlage deines Arbeitsvertrags. 


  • Du gestaltest Developer Workflows ganzheitlich – vom lokalen Setup über CI/CD und Deployment bis hin zum laufenden Betrieb. Dabei beschäftigst du dich unter anderem mit Containerisierung, Cloud-Native-Praktiken, GitOps und Telemetrie, mit der wir überprüfen können, ob das, was wir entwickeln, auch tatsächlich funktioniert. Zunehmend bedeutet das auch, Tools so zu entwickeln, dass sie nicht nur für Menschen im Terminal, sondern ebenso für AI Agents und CI-Pipelines geeignet sind. Gleichzeitig nutzen wir selbst AI-Tools, um unsere Lösungen schneller und effizienter zu entwickeln und zu warten.

  • Du entwickelst die Grundlagen unseres Open-Source-Ökosystems weiter – von der CLI über APIs bis hin zu den Tools und Integrationen, die sie umgeben.

  • Du setzt hohe Standards für Codequalität. Gut getestet, sauber strukturiert und so entwickelt, dass der Code langfristig wartbar ist – nicht nur schnell ausgeliefert. Dazu gehören für uns auch klare Konventionen und Tooling, die dafür sorgen, dass diese Standards mit wachsendem Team und Codebestand erhalten bleiben.

  • Du bringst dich aktiv in unsere Open-Source-Community ein. Du reviewst Contributions, verbesserst Dokumentationen und stehst im Austausch mit den Entwickler, die deine Tools täglich nutzen.

  • Du verbindest Teams und Perspektiven. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Core-, SaaS/PaaS-, Documentation- und Community-Teams zusammen, damit unser Tooling die tatsächlichen Bedürfnisse unserer Developer Community widerspiegelt.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Erfahrung mit Go ist ideal. Eines der Tools, auf das wir aktuell einen besonderen Fokus legen, basiert auf Go. Du musst kein Go-Experte bzw. keine Go-Expertin sein – wichtiger sind deine Motivation und deine Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten.

  • PHP-Kenntnisse, idealerweise mit Symfony, sind ein starkes Plus. Teile unseres Toolings, beispielsweise Deployment-Helfer, basieren direkt auf PHP. Gleichzeitig hilft dir dieses Wissen dabei, das Shopware-Ökosystem, für das unsere CLI entwickelt wird, noch besser zu verstehen.

  • Du begeisterst dich wirklich für Developer Tools und hast Empathie für die Menschen, die sie verwenden. Vielleicht hast du bereits an Projekten mit klarem DX-Fokus gearbeitet, eigene Side Projects entwickelt, zu CLIs oder Developer Tooling beigetragen – Open Source oder anderweitig – oder du bist einfach die Person im Team, die ein Issue erstellt, wenn ein Workflow unnötig umständlich ist.

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung darin, Developer Experience zu verbessern, beispielsweise durch CLI-Tooling, Automatisierung, APIs, Scaffolding oder die Optimierung von Entwicklungsworkflows.

  • Automatisierte Tests und CI-Workflows gehören für dich zum Engineering-Alltag. Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wie sich Tools nahtlos in bestehende Developer-Ökosysteme integrieren lassen.

  • Du nutzt AI-gestützte Entwicklungsworkflows aktiv, zum Beispiel beim Coding, bei Dokumentation oder Automatisierung. Gleichzeitig setzt du dich kritisch damit auseinander, wo AI Engineering tatsächlich effizienter macht – und wo nicht. Begriffe wie MCP oder AI Skills sind dir nicht fremd.

  • Du arbeitest gerne offen und transparent. Dein Code, deine Pull Requests und technische Entscheidungen sind für eine öffentliche Community sichtbar – und du fühlst dich mit dieser Transparenz wohl.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und verbindlich, insbesondere in der asynchronen Zusammenarbeit, und kannst sowohl mit internen Stakeholdern als auch mit externen Contributor erfolgreich zusammenarbeiten.

  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Bevor du dich bewirbst: Nimm dir vor deiner Bewerbung etwa zehn Minuten Zeit: Installiere unsere shopware-cli, probiere einige Commands aus und wirf einen Blick in das Repository. Im Bewerbungsprozess werden wir dich fragen, was du daran verändern würdest – und warum.

Es lohnt sich also, dir schon vorher ein paar Gedanken dazu zu machen.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Josephine Scheffler und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

  • Fluency in English (C1+) is required. German (C1) is a plus, but not a must-have.

jobs.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

About the role 

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. 

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently.

  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents.

Some of the challenges waiting for you

  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation).

What we offer
